events.title: Gestapo selection and taking of Jews
events.summary: Gestapo personnel selected fifteen Jews, including Abraham Zilberstein and Bnei Menachem, took them to fields, and forced them to exhume and load bodies.
events.uncertaintyNote: The text says they were taken away but does not explicitly state that they were arrested.
